description: This file defines API routes for AI-powered test authoring, including request/response schemas, a Flask Blueprint, and a REST endpoint that generates suggested test steps using an external service.

classes.name: AuthorRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for validating AI authoring request data, including prompt and optional context.

classes.name: AuthorResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for formatting the response with suggested steps and rationale.

classes.name: AIAuthorResource
classes.description: REST API resource handling AI authoring requests at /author endpoint.

methods.name: _validate_content
methods.description: Validates that the prompt is a non-empty string.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to generate suggested test steps based on input prompt and context.
